scope: Only two original pictures and the printed fixed examples in 190/192. No general solution to the parity exercises and no timing of MMIX operators.

figureAssets.method: Matched all 25×61 actual Chinese pixel centers and English vector fills. Original artwork preserved, including its right-edge difference from the formula applied to Figure 17(a).

figureAssets.symmetry: horizontal reflection, vertical reflection and transpose
figureAssets.method: Original one-bit active data retained; all active cells satisfy the rook-neighbor recurrence and every row and column has a one.

fixedWidth120.firstReturnArgument: Zero boundary rows at 0 and the first positive zero index d imply r_(d+k)=r_(d−k) by the reversible recurrence over GF(2); hence the row sequence repeats with 2d and zeros occur exactly at multiples of d. Therefore d divides the tested nonzero target index with a zero row. Checking each target/prime factor excludes all earlier first-zero divisors.

zeroWidthInitialValue: At q=1 the width is zero, so there can be no nonzero row. The maximum zero-row count is 0, giving c(1)=1. The nonempty widths q=2–9 were enumerated by exact row recurrence in the witness.
